description: Generated by go run ./cmd/surface-tracker. Each op is POST <base>/<op> with the request as the JSON body; a refusal is a non-2xx {"error","detail"}. documents gives the JSON shape of each file an op reply captures, keyed by its path in the capture. Each op's timeout_seconds is its deadline: an interruptible op stops and answers 504 deadline-exceeded once it passes; any other op may run past it in the worker, and timeout_seconds is how long to wait for it.
